hero.headline: When it's a lot, cast a hexagram.
hero.shotAlt: The Master's cast result screen: hexagram on top, reading below.
what.title: An app for studying Chinese folk fate arts: cast, chart, keep cases. A cat Daoist lives inside.
case.title: One case, four views
case.lead: Ba Zi, Zi Wei, relationships and Ask all live in one case, and every hexagram cast for this person stays under that name, so you can trace it back.
case.steps.0.title: Create a case
case.steps.0.body: Choose solar, lunar or Four Pillars. Pick a birth place by province and city, or enter longitude. Outside UTC+8, pick a time zone.
case.steps.1.title: Open Zi Wei Dou Shu
case.steps.1.body: Switch three chart styles with one control. Layer major cycles, Annual and Monthly. Tap a palace to set the Taiji point.
case.steps.2.title: Set up Ba Zi
case.steps.2.body: Each pillar has ten rows, from Main Star to Nayin and Symbolic Stars. The Details chart uses six pillars, and the table changes with each major cycle.
case.steps.3.title: Cast a hexagram for them
case.steps.3.body: Choose who you are asking for, give two numbers, and the hexagram is cast on your device, read for you.
case.steps.4.title: Look back at each hexagram
case.steps.4.body: The case's Ask view lists every hexagram under this name, newest first: date, question, hexagrams and fortune. Tap one to reopen that result page.

tools.title: Four tools
tools.cards.0.name: Mei Hua Yi Shu divination
tools.cards.0.line: Two numbers, and the hexagram is cast on the spot. A third-party AI writes the reading.
tools.cards.0.detail: Trigrams come from Earlier Heaven numbers; the numbers plus the hour set the moving line. Primary, nuclear and changed hexagrams, body and use, cast on your device with a SHA-256 fingerprint. The reading follows the hexagram, and its tone comes from body and use, not the model. Cast without a question for a plain hexagram. History and memory stay per case, on your device.
tools.cards.1.name: Zi Wei Dou Shu
tools.cards.1.line: Three chart styles, five fortune layers, Chart Patterns by the rules.
tools.cards.1.detail: One birth time builds San He, Flying Star and Four Transformations charts, with major cycle, annual, monthly, daily and hourly layers. Chart Patterns checks 84 rules and names the layer each comes from. The 23 star-setting slots fold into one star code; paste someone's code and charts match. Zizhan casting and Four Pillars lookup sit in More; hold a star name for its glossary card.
tools.cards.2.name: Ba Zi chart
tools.cards.2.line: Four Pillars in ten rows, six pillars in seven columns; cycles, years and months follow.
tools.cards.2.detail: Four tabs: Profile, Chart, Details, Notes. The Four Pillars table has ten rows, from main star to Symbolic Stars, colored by element. Details shows the current major cycle and year up top, and you swipe through cycles, years and months. Symbolic Stars group by pillar and cycle; clashes and combinations are labeled. Six rules for hidden stems; hold any field for its glossary entry.
tools.cards.3.name: Case library
tools.cards.3.line: One case per person: group, filter, back up, sync. Hexagrams stay with their cases.
tools.cards.3.detail: Rename all eight groups. Sort four ways, browse by initial or group, filter by gender, group, Day Master element or stem, zodiac and birth decade; rows show the Four Pillars. Back up to iCloud or Files, with a daily local backup keeping the last seven. A shared case merges into the other library; iCloud devices sync automatically. Delete a case and its hexagrams go too.
remembers.text: A chatbot forgets what you asked last time. The Master remembers, cast after cast.
academy.text: Five arts, 154 classics, 2,408 chapters, all in the app and readable offline. Hold a name on the chart to read what it means.
offline.text: Your chart runs on your phone, even offline.
faq.items.0.question: Is this real fortune telling?
faq.items.0.answer: No. It is a tool for studying Chinese folk fate arts, for fun and company. It does not predict, change fate or bring luck, and never claims to be right. Big decisions need a qualified person.
faq.items.1.question: Will the same numbers give the same hexagram?
faq.items.1.answer: The same number and the same hour always give the same hexagram by a fixed method. No dice. Once cast, the hexagram stays fixed; the third-party AI service only writes the reading.
faq.items.2.question: Do I need internet to cast a chart?
faq.items.2.answer: No. Zi Wei and Ba Zi charts are both calculated on your device, so they work in Airplane Mode and your birth details never leave it. Chart Patterns and Four Pillars lookup need a connection.
faq.items.3.question: How do San He, Four Transformations and Flying Star differ?
faq.items.3.answer: San He shows star brightness, birth-year Four Transformations and stacked fortune layers. Flying Star shows palace-stem transforms and the cause palace. Four Transformations enlarges the four stars and draws their lines. Switch between the three anytime, all on your device.
faq.items.4.question: Will I lose my cases?
faq.items.4.answer: Your cases stay on your device and in your own private iCloud. You can save one to Files to share, and import it back. The app backs up daily on your device, keeping the last seven. Only you can delete them.
faq.items.5.question: How does the Master remember what I asked?
faq.items.5.answer: After each reading, the Master saves a short note on your phone, kept per case. Next time you ask about the same person, at most three notes may come in, used just for that reading, and you can turn this off anytime.
faq.items.6.question: Who writes the readings?
faq.items.6.answer: The hexagram is cast on your phone, the backend checks it, then a third-party AI service writes the reading. Your first online ask asks for consent, and readings are limited per day.
